SELECT 
  date_trunc('day', created_at) as date,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(amount) as total_amount,
  AVG(amount) as avg_amount
FROM transactions
WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
GROUP BY date_trunc('day', created_at)
ORDER BY date ASC;

INSERT INTO forecasting_results (
  analysis_id,
  forecast_period_start,
  forecast_period_end,
  historical_data_points,
  trend_direction,
  ensemble_forecast,
  avg_predicted_value,
  percent_change,
  avg_confidence_score,
  models_agreement_rate,
  insights,
  risk_factors,
  models_used,
  processing_time_ms
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.analysis_id }}',
  CURRENT_DATE,
  CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '7 days',
  {{ $json.historical_summary.data_points }},
  '{{ $json.historical_summary.trend }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.ensemble_forecast) }}',
  {{ $json.forecast_metrics.avg_predicted_value }},
  '{{ $json.forecast_metrics.percent_change_from_recent }}',
  {{ $json.forecast_metrics.avg_confidence_score }},
  '{{ $json.forecast_metrics.models_agreement_rate }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.insights) }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.risk_factors) }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.metadata.models_used) }}',
  {{ $json.metadata.processing_time_ms }}
) RETURNING *;
